Stop only when the failed instance has no recoverable previous state or the official runtime cannot start, and preserve that failure evidence.

failureGuidance.summary: One or more independent re-enhancement reviews or their aggregate is missing.

evidenceReferences.quote: Use an explicit `TransitionGroup` with `strategy: whenAllPass` for independent external `SubagentCall` reviews and validations that share one join state. The SO runtime registers every expected transition in one persisted batch and keeps the workflow at the current state until every result has been returned. A missing or duplicate result fails closed. Use this only for independent external transitions; keep synchronous mutations and ordered checks in separate serial groups. Legacy wire value `all` must be migrated and must not be authored.

failureGuidance.summary: One or more independent planning results or their aggregate is missing.

failureGuidance.summary: The complete pre-repair findings aggregate is missing.

evidenceReferences.quote: - Preserve each finding's severity, evidence reference, proposed action, preserved strength, and one disposition: `accepted`, `rebutted`, or `needs_validation`.

failureGuidance.summary: One or more independent post-fix validation results or their aggregate is missing.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Wait for every post-fix validator, aggregate all results, and keep the workflow before serial validation until the aggregate is complete.

evidenceReferences.quote: After each parallel review batch, run one explicit aggregation step that preserves every finding, source, severity, and disposition (`accepted`, `rebutted`, or `needs_validation`). Run one coordinated batch repair against the complete aggregate. Do not launch one rewrite per finding. Then run the independent post-fix validators as a second parallel batch, aggregate their results, and finish with one serial validation stage for JSON, graph/dataflow, compile, and ordered runtime checks before official run/resume continuation.

parameters.skillHint: Run the local workflow designer at assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-designer.agent.md. Consume the bounded referencePackManifest, schemaDemoInput, and phaseDesignPolicy before authoring. Count authored states only; at 40 or more, freeze and check a typed skeleton, then author isolated phases capped at 25 states as a soft limit. Use the same selected SO apphost for skeleton-check, phase-compile, impact, merge, and full compile. Phase compilation is static only. Aggregate interface changes, revalidate affected phases, merge into a new candidate, and fully compile that exact candidate; never migrate a live workflow. Cap repairs at three attempts per phase and two after-merge compile rounds. Return phase_design_evidence linked to phaseDesignEvidence inside the existing static-contract-review.json; do not create a fourth report. Return the checked-in template, dispatch record, gate review, and the three runtime-owned workflow-design records. Save those records outside the skill bundle and use verified relative evidence references. Consume evidenceNodeMapAnalysis and map the skill being enhanced's SKILL.md first as Priority 1. For each new or changed context_fields entry, compare its JSON/container type with an independent actual SO producer output or authoritative producer schema. Run inspect-contract-fragment and a minimal same-apphost probe before broad tests; the catalog echo alone does not prove business types. Record contextFieldTypeComparisons in static-contract-review.json; unknown type evidence blocks readiness.

transition.finalize_lock.name: Finalize official completion manifest and governance verdict
transition.finalize_lock.description: Publish an external completion manifest after the official runnable route has produced enough runtime-owned evidence. This step references checked-in source deliverables, summarizes the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist, and does not claim to recreate the checked-in files.

parameters.content:
# Governance Verdict
- Verdict rule: this manifest summarizes governed completion only when the mapped runtime-owned evidence families below already exist on the official runnable route; it does not create replacement route-proof evidence inside this terminal step.
- Current status: completed on the terminal official runnable route that emitted this manifest.
- Current node: state.done
- Final Done reached: yes on the route that emitted this manifest.
- Missing evidence rule: any null or missing mapped evidence family below must be reported as missing evidence and blocks a compliant interpretation outside this manifest.
- Next action: use commit_report_ready and this runtime-owned completion manifest for final handoff.

# Evidence Checklist
- workflow_runtime_copy_json: runtime-owned workflow copy for the official run chain.
- event_log_file: runtime-owned event log for the same chain.
- review_fix_loop_evidence: prerequisite review and fix lineage for this slice.
- commit_report_ready: completion-time handoff readiness evidence.
- checked_in_skill_markdown_asset: SKILL.md remains the authoritative checked-in source deliverable.
- checked_in_package_lock_asset: assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json remains the authoritative checked-in runtime lock.
- node_to_file_map: assets/so-workflow/node-to-file-map.md remains the authoritative node-to-artifact map.
- internal_document_evidence: target-local document snapshots and manifest provenance were inspected under the declared root of the skill being enhanced.
- completion_manifest_reference: this runtime-owned manifest reference anchors the final verdict surface.
- completion_manifest_md: this human-reviewable manifest is the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist surface.

This manifest summarizes governed completion from the existing runtime-owned evidence families. It does not replace those evidence families, it does not claim to recreate checked-in source deliverables, and it does not self-certify route-proof evidence that was absent before the terminal step.

transition.aggregate_post_fix_validation.name: Aggregate post-fix validation
transition.aggregate_post_fix_validation.description: Require the designated trusted aggregator's snapshot-comparison attestation before serial validation; the runtime does not independently compare the quote.

parameters.skillHint: Aggregate every expected post-fix result against the same bounded shared context. Verify the policy quote against the exact bounded SKILL.md snapshot and inclusive line range. Set evidenceQuoteVerified to true only after an exact match. Set status to complete only when the policy passes, verification is true, each expected result is present exactly once, and no blockers or regressions remain. Otherwise set status to blocked and verification to false. Preserve every finding and disposition; do not repair files. This flag is a trusted-aggregator attestation, not runtime-independent proof: the runtime validates the flag and evidence shape but does not compare the quote with the external snapshot. Do not claim anti-forgery; if resume payloads are outside the trusted boundary, block pending independent verification.

transition.run_serial_validation.name: Run final serial validation
transition.run_serial_validation.description: Perform the final ordered validation only after the complete post-fix validation aggregate exists.

parameters.skillHint: Run the final ordered validation in this order: parse JSON, check duplicate and graph references, check projections and output producers, compile with the current SO runtime, compile the matching schema/demo pair, run inherited and replacement three-node probes on that exact runtime through final Done, verify the batch migration manifest, index durable decision evidence, then run the ordered target workflow check. Return serial_validation_evidence, runtime_semantic_probe_evidence, batch_migration_evidence, decision_evidence_manifest, review_fix_loop_evidence, and commit_report_ready together.
parameters.command: structured-json -> graph-dataflow -> the direct SO apphost compile -> schema-demo compile -> exact-version differential run -> batch migration verify -> decision evidence index -> ordered runtime check
